adapterWarnings: interval ('+N') heightening text is not a pure damage bump — kept as a description appendix only, not structurally represented

description.value:
You call a searing lance of solar light from the peak of Elysium in response to being harmed. This spell can only be cast as a reaction triggered when a creature within 60 feet that you can see deals damage to you.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 2d10 vitality damage.

Failure The creature takes 5d10 vitality damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled]{Dazzled} until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure The creature takes 10d10 vitality damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Blinded]{Blinded} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage on failure increases by 2d10 (and doubles on critical failure).

target.value: 1 creature that damaged you this turn
